title: Semantic Authority Graph and Claim Reasoning Projection
goal: Extend the DB current-state capsule with a governed semantic authority graph summary and a claim-registry / claim-support reasoning projection so the runtime can answer claim and authority questions without broad registry inspection.

problem.current_state: The runtime already projects semantic RT, debt blockers, and historical residue, but the current-state capsule still leaves the semantic authority graph and claim reasoning split across separate registry lookups.
problem.gap: Agents still need to consult the claim registry and support matrix directly to understand how governed claims are structured and supported.

objectives: Surface the full semantic authority graph summary in current-state.
Surface claim-registry and claim-support summaries in current-state.
Expose DB claim-evidence link coverage explicitly, including when the table is empty.
Resolve DEBT_DB_GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME_STATE_002 in the governed debt registry.
acceptance_criteria: current-state output includes semantic authority graph summary.
current-state output includes claim-registry and claim-support summary.
current-state output reports claim-evidence link coverage explicitly.
global_validate.py passes without introducing new governance regressions.
